name: Meridian Logistic Group
desc: Meridian Logistic Group transformed its global financial operations by replacing manual, error-prone Excel processes with Prophix. The transition enabled the logistics leader to slash close times by 71% and unlock millions in trapped cash through automated, real-time financial visibility.
whoText: Meridian Logistic Group is a global logistics leader specializing in warehousing, freight, and last-mile delivery. With 3,400 employees and a lean finance team of 28, they rely on Prophix to maintain operational agility across 14 countries.

krs.text: Reduced quarterly close cycle from 21 days to just 6 days.
Eliminated manual mapping errors and audit risks associated with 47 disparate spreadsheet templates.
Transitioned finance staff from manual data entry to high-value FP&A and analytical roles.
Achieved real-time visibility into global cash positions across 12 currencies.

data.label: THE CHALLENGE
data.heading: Breaking Free from the 'Heroic' Excel Close
data.body:
Operating across 14 countries with 47 different spreadsheet templates, Meridian’s finance team was trapped in a cycle of manual labor. The process required six staff members to work fourteen-hour days for three weeks every quarter just to complete a consolidation.

Beyond the unsustainable workload, the reliance on manual Excel processes led to significant errors, including a material restatement that caused major friction with auditors and the board. The team was losing top talent to burnout and lacked the visibility needed to manage global cash effectively.

data.label: THE SOLUTION
data.heading: Automating Global Financial Consolidation
data.body:
Meridian selected Prophix for its robust Financial Consolidation and Intercompany Management capabilities. The implementation team worked closely with Meridian to standardize their chart of accounts, moving them from fragmented spreadsheets to a unified, automated platform.

By automating intercompany reconciliations—which dropped from eight days to four hours—the team was able to focus on higher-level financial strategy. The integration of Cash Management also provided the treasury team with the real-time visibility required to optimize liquidity across their global entities.

data.label: THE RESULTS
data.heading: Driving Transparency and Strategic Growth
data.body:
The impact was immediate: the first close on Prophix was completed in six days, a 71% improvement. This newfound efficiency allowed the company to redeploy two finance team members to focus on FP&A Plus and scenario planning, shifting the department from a data-processing unit to a strategic partner.

The board and PE sponsors have noted a significant increase in financial transparency, with reporting packs arriving weeks earlier than before. Furthermore, the team successfully identified €4.2 million in trapped cash within the first month of using the system, directly impacting the company's bottom line.

data.title: THE FIRST CLOSE
data.quote: The first close on Prophix felt like cheating. And I mean that in the best possible way.

data.title: THE COST OF MANUAL WORK
data.quote: You are spending human capital on work that software should be doing, and that cost is invisible until you stop doing it.
